steps.en: Turn it on for this session
Loads the ten rules and keeps applying them for the rest of the session
steps.zh: 加载这十条规则，并在余下会话里持续生效

steps.en: Ask for what you want, as usual
Answers action-first: numbered steps, progress restated, no preamble or closer
steps.zh: 动作先行地回答：编号步骤、复述进度，无铺垫无收尾

steps.en: Say stop when you want your normal style back
steps.zh: 想恢复原样时说一句 stop

steps.en: Confirms in one line and reverts for the session
steps.zh: 一句话确认，本会话恢复默认风格

value.en: The answer is in the first line, and you stop re-reading replies to find the one thing you can act on
value.zh: 答案就在第一行，不必为了找那一句可执行的话把整条回复再读一遍
